description.zh: 向访客解释「我们是谁、为什么做这件事」的品牌页面：开头用一句使命宣言定调，中段以创始故事、发展历程或团队照片建立信任，再用价值观与关键数据支撑，结尾导向联系、招聘或产品。
description.en: A brand page explaining who you are: a mission statement sets the tone, then story and milestones build trust, and the end points to contact or careers.

use_when.zh: 访客在决策前想了解团队与背景
use_when.en: Visitors want to know the team and background before deciding

use_when.zh: 品牌需要传达使命与价值观
use_when.en: The brand needs to communicate mission and values

use_when.zh: 招聘、融资或合作需要可信的自我介绍
use_when.en: Hiring, funding or partnerships need a credible introduction

avoid_when.zh: 用户只关心功能与价格（用落地页或定价页更合适）
avoid_when.en: Users only care about features and price — use a landing or pricing page

avoid_when.zh: 团队或公司信息尚未确定
avoid_when.en: Team or company details are not settled yet

avoid_when.zh: 需要承载复杂操作流程
avoid_when.en: The page must carry complex task flows

note.zh: 以创始人叙事为主线，情绪与图片占主导
note.en: A founder-led narrative where emotion and imagery lead

note.zh: 头像网格 + 职位与简介，强调人
note.en: Avatar grid with roles and short bios, putting people first

note.zh: 以时间线串起里程碑与关键数据
note.en: A timeline strings milestones and key numbers together

note.zh: 站点导航与主 CTA，与全站保持一致。
note.en: Site nav and primary CTA, consistent with the rest of the site.

note.zh: 一句加大的主张配一张品牌照片，先回答「我们为何存在」。
note.en: One oversized statement beside a brand image answers why you exist.

note.zh: 创始故事或时间线，用具体事件与年份建立可信度。
note.en: The origin story or timeline builds credibility with concrete events and years.

note.zh: 头像、姓名与职位网格，规模小则给每人一句简介。
note.en: A grid of avatars, names and roles, with one line each for small teams.

note.zh: 三到四条原则，每条一句解释，避免空泛口号。
note.en: Three or four principles, each with one line of explanation, not slogans.

note.zh: 导向联系、招聘或产品体验，给读者下一步。
note.en: Points to contact, careers or the product, giving readers a next step.

notes.zh: 分区纵向堆叠，团队与价值观用 auto-fit 网格；头像统一正方形并 object-fit: cover，避免拉伸。长页在分区进入时做轻微淡入，需尊重 prefers-reduced-motion；文字与图片的对比度要达 WCAG AA。
notes.en: Stack sections vertically; lay the team and values out with an auto-fit grid; keep avatars square and object-fit: cover so they never stretch. Fade sections in as they enter, respecting prefers-reduced-motion, and keep text-on-image contrast at WCAG AA.

basic.zh: 创建一个关于页，包含使命宣言、团队介绍和价值观。
basic.en: Create an about page with a mission statement, team section and values.

design.zh: 设计品牌关于页：顶部大标题使命宣言 + 品牌图；中段时间线串起里程碑；团队区四列头像卡，每张含姓名与职位；价值观三列图标 + 短句；结尾 CTA 横幅指向联系我们与加入我们。深浅色一致，进场轻微淡入。
design.en: Design a brand about page: a large mission headline with a brand image; a timeline of milestones; a four-column team grid with name and role cards; a three-column values row with short lines; a closing CTA banner to contact and careers. Theme-consistent with subtle fade-ins.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现关于页：语义化 section，团队与价值观用 grid auto-fit；头像固定比例并 object-fit: cover；时间线用有序列表表达先后；进场动画用 IntersectionObserver 并尊重 prefers-reduced-motion；不新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind about page: semantic sections; team and values on an auto-fit grid; avatars with a fixed ratio and object-fit: cover; the timeline as an ordered list; entry animation via IntersectionObserver respecting prefers-reduced-motion; no new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现关于页。

先检查现有布局壳、卡片与头像组件，优先复用。
要求：
- 使命宣言 + 故事/时间线 + 团队 + 价值观 + CTA
- 团队与价值观用自适应网格，头像不变形
- 时间线语义化为有序列表
- 图片有 alt，文字对比度达 AA
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement the about page in the current project.

Inspect the existing layout shell, card and avatar components first; reuse them.
Requirements:
- Mission + story/timeline + team + values + CTA
- Team and values on an adaptive grid; avatars never distort
- Timeline marked up as an ordered list
- Images carry alt text; text meets AA contrast
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
